Rebecca Honig (born Rebecca Handler) is an American voice actress for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Honig began to provide voices for starting with the seventh season. She continued voicing characters up until 4Kids gave up the dubbing rights to Pokémon USA and TAJ Productions.
